task: Unbounded structural progress toward Seymour's second-neighborhood conjecture

definitions.graph: Finite nonempty oriented graph: no loops and no directed two-cycles.
definitions.N2: Vertices at directed distance EXACTLY two; excludes the vertex itself and all first neighbors.
definitions.minimal_class: Strongly connected and all g>0, minimal under deletion of ANY nonempty arc set on the fixed vertex set.
definitions.actual_source: A vertex which really witnesses nonconvenience of a direction on a BAD missing pair, not merely a vertex with positive eta.
definitions.P: Other vertices from which the chosen vertex is not reachable within at most two original steps.
definitions.t: Number of original far heads not protected by incoming-neighborhood nesting.

repairs_and_rejected_shortcuts: Maximum-reference rigidity needs ALL original protection extensions, or explicit closure under using any admissible median as a new reference. A four-vertex control rejects arbitrary finite subfamilies.
The forced alternative reference family is not a set-theoretic superset of the canonical family. Only the proven median-score optimization dominance is used.
A released reversal of a uniquely convenient GOOD pair may produce new far heads; original BAD-source transfer cannot be carried across to the forced family unchanged.
Having no added first neighbors does not by itself imply feed transfer. Exact seven- and ten-vertex controls have positive-original-gap maximum-completion feeds but have Seymour vertices elsewhere.
The older five-vertex skew-equilibrium control is incomplete, not a tournament; its scope has been clarified in both old fragments.
Tournament losing-density support rigidity is not median-order FLEX rigidity; a six-point tournament control disproves the proposed implication.
Packet estimates require nonempty P. They must not be silently applied to the empty-P branch.
No theorem giving two distinct median feeds in every sink-free tournament is used; a four-vertex counterexample to that assertion was verified.
assurance_limits: All minimal-counterexample corollaries depend on the explicitly retained and internally reviewed foundation lemmas.
Small-graph audits supplement mathematical proofs; they do not prove the conjecture or exhaust unknown counterexamples.
Internal multi-agent review is not external peer review or proof-assistant verification.
Novelty, priority and journal suitability have not been fully assessed.
The complete conjecture is not solved and no actual all-deficient oriented graph has been found.
Previous delivered PDF and desktop copy remain unchanged; current new proofs are mergeable F:-stored source fragments.
